a.lede: The web host said hackers exploited a vulnerability to access customer emails and files during a "deliberate attack."
a.title: Hackers stole DreamHost customer files and inboxes during months-long attack

b.lede: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. [...]
b.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
